summary.text: 馬 means “horse” and is explained as a picture of that animal. The angular modern form has obscured much of the outline, but the four dots below are described as descendants of the legs. Their resemblance to the fire component 灬 does not make fire part of this character’s origin.

history.text: The supplied descriptions identify a head, mane, tail and legs in the horse picture. Wiktionary reports that the head was often reduced to an eye-like form in bronze inscriptions and that the legs eventually became four dots. These reported changes help connect the animal outline with the later written form.
